figures.caption: Figure 3: Structure of the interleaved reasoning endogenous chain-of-thought model. At each decoding step, the fine-grained hidden state is first used to predict a coarse-grained semantic embedding, which is then fused with the decoder contextual state via a gating injection module. The resulting enhanced fine-grained representation is passed to the fine-grained prediction head to output the final recommendation.
